testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore work-feature entries in the part browser: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:441:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore work-feature entries in the part browser ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited ✔ And the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch ✔ And Hide Work Features is unchecked in browser Display Preferences ✔ When the user selects Hide Work Features ✔ Then the Origin branch is hidden from the browser ✔ And the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible ✔ When the user reopens browser Display Preferences ✔ Then Hide Work Features is checked ✔ When the user selects Hide Work Features again ✔ Then the Origin branch returns to the browser in a collapsed state ✔ And the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible
